verdict.rationale: Groq's docs refer to on-demand pricing: Flex 'pricing matches the on-demand tier' and Batch runs at '50% lower cost'. A community user cited a publicly listed price of $0.27/1M tokens, so some per-token pricing has been visible without sales contact. However, another user reports Groq switched to 'call us for quotes' for new models, which undercuts the 'every hosted model' part of the story. missing for 10: a first-party public per-model pricing page in evidence, confirmation that all hosted models (including new ones) have self-serve listed prices, current independent corroboration.
